items.title: Hot reload
items.body: Reload modules while scripts are running. Functions get swapped in place so anything holding them picks up the new code, and module state carries over.

items.title: Publish to crates.io
items.body: The crates already package fine, it just needs pushing.

items.title: Faster calls, again
items.body: Calls are still where Luau is furthest ahead (`callbacks` is about 3.3× faster there), so another round on that.
